verdict_note: No build break and no failing test found by reading (no cargo run). One hang-class defect in the new export gate (F1: every linked frame re-hashes its file, uncached and with no cancel check) and one deviation from the brief's binding refusal order (F2: the STU-ASSET-009 gate runs after preflight and after all shaping). Both are small, local edits in layout_place.rs and in layout_export.rs hunks that stay disjoint from SMB-TYPE-INDENT-SPACING-1; fixing them before the one bundled run avoids a second run. F3 is low (quadratic but cancelable). The undo step, the place.rs refactor, the fit maths, the frame guard, the ppi receipt and the JobPort admission check out (see checked).

findings.severity: medium (hang class: unbounded, uncancelable export time)
findings.where: crates/hsk-studio-harness-view/src/view/layout_place.rs:431-466 (layout_pdf_placements loop; self.link_state at :439); place.rs:543-548 (link_state builds LinkedFileResolver with no cancel token); hsk-studio-package/src/linked.rs:47-110 (check streams and sha256-hashes the whole file, up to MAX_SOURCE_BYTES = 512 MiB, no cancel); called from layout_export.rs:685 inside as_export_job
findings.what: The link gate calls link_state once per graphic frame. Each call canonicalizes, opens and hashes the full linked file. Frames that share one placed source (source_for shares a linked file by uri and digest, place.rs:828-838) re-hash the same file once per frame. The loop has no cancel check, and the resolver takes no token, so a canceled export job keeps reading until every frame is done; as_export_job can only settle after the closure returns.
findings.scenario: A catalogue with 500 frames placed from one 300 MB linked TIFF: one layout.export_pdf reads and hashes 150 GB before lowering, and canceling the token does not stop it. A hostile package with 65536 graphic_frames records over one 512 MiB linked source (MAX_GRAPHIC_FRAMES allows it) hashes about 32 TiB: effectively a hang.
findings.fix: In layout_pdf_placements, memoize the state per source_id (BTreeMap<&str, &'static str>) so each source is hashed once per export, and call self.cancel.check() at the top of each frame iteration, mapping it to ("canceled", ...) so as_export_job settles JobOutcome::Canceled (layout_export.rs:547). Add the brief's hostile case 'a canceled token during export': canceled -> code canceled, no file written. Optional: a per-file cancel check inside the hash loop belongs to the package crate (out of scope here).

findings.severity: low-medium (refusal order contrary to binding brief item 5; wasted work before a fail-closed refusal)
findings.where: crates/hsk-studio-harness-view/src/view/layout_export.rs:682-685 (gate) versus :557-560 (preflight), :575 (layout_text_over_budget), :591-640 (shaping, hyphenation, reflow); brief lane-smb-layout-place-1.md item 5 'STU-ASSET-009 gate before any shaping'
findings.what: The builder's own report places the link gate after shaping. layout_pdf_placements needs only live.doc.document and live.rec.longdoc.graphic_frames, both available right after the preflight check at :560, but runs after every story is planned, shaped, hyphenated and reflowed. A missing or modified link therefore loses to layout_text_over_budget, story_paragraph_range, font and reflow refusals and to canceled. The export still writes nothing on a link refusal, so no file is wrong.
findings.scenario: A layout with a modified linked picture and a story over MAX_EXPORT_TEXT_BYTES: layout.export_pdf refuses layout_text_over_budget. The model fixes the text, exports again, and only then learns placed_link_modified. A large document with a missing link pays the whole shaping cost before every refusal.
findings.fix: Move `let frames = &rec.longdoc.graphic_frames;` and the layout_pdf_placements call to just after the preflight check at :560, keeping graphics and placements for later use. That edit is at about :557-562, outside the brief's hunk list (:52-57, :193-205, :665-698) but far from :768-775, so the rebase against SMB-TYPE-INDENT-SPACING-1 stays clean. Ask the lead to accept the hunk, or record the order as a lead ruling if the lead keeps it as it is. No current process test drives a link refusal together with a text or preflight error, so neither order breaks a test.

findings.severity: low (quadratic at the frame budget; cancelable through the decode token)
findings.where: crates/hsk-studio-harness-view/src/view/layout_place.rs:215-226 (is_graphic_frame decodes the whole layout_records entry per call); place.rs:686-688 (placement_tiles calls it per instance), place.rs:1047 (any() per instance), place.rs:850 (transform_inner)
findings.what: Each is_graphic_frame call runs LayoutRecords::decode over the full entry, and that entry grows with the frame count. update_all_modified calls it twice per instance of a modified source, so the decode work is O(N^2) in frames.
findings.scenario: A layout with 20000 frames that share one modified linked source: Update All Links runs about 40000 decodes of a multi-MB entry before staging tiles. At MAX_GRAPHIC_FRAMES the decoding alone takes hours. Cancel does stop it, through the decode's token.
findings.fix: Decode the frame layer ids once per command (a BTreeSet from graphic_frames_now) and pass them to placement_tiles and the resized check in update_inner. transform_inner can keep the single call.

lead_questions: LayoutAssets::profile (layout_assets.rs:111-113) now returns Prism's linear-sRGB ICC for every paint colour bound to the working-space id. pdf_export.rs:631 (gradients) and :1169 (solid fills and strokes) then draw such colours as ICCBased(linear) where they were DeviceRgb with paint_profile_unresolved, in every layout PDF, with or without pictures. Brief item 5 asks for this. Whether Assigned paint colours hold linear values is UNVERIFIED; the harness's own authoring paths bind Unassigned (vector/swatch.rs:167, interop.rs:382), so imported documents are the likely exposure. LayoutRecords::parse then fails validate_graphic_frame (folio longdoc.rs:1693-1697), so every layout edit refuses layout_records_stale, and layout_doc falls back to an empty longdoc (shell.rs:1489-1499): the export drops sections, page labels and tables until the delete is undone. This is a pre-existing class (harness.rs submit_layout comment, review F4 of b21616b7) that pictures make reachable. Should this lane prune the frame, or is it a later slice? Reachability by run is UNVERIFIED (run.placement of a spread-parented layer).

ppi: only TIFF resolution reaches the import receipt (layout_place.rs:85-99). PNG pHYs and JPEG JFIF density go to 72 because their decoders do not report them. The ruling says 'the decoder's ppi when the format states one'. Confirm this reading, or open an SD item for PNG and JPEG density.

Module docs, place.rs:79-81, say the canvas 'shows the layer's tiles at the spread origin' (labelled NOT_INSPECTED). By reading this looks wrong (see canvas_origin_judgement). A no-context model reads this line, so the builder should reword it to 'not drawn on the viewer canvas'.
canvas_origin_judgement: Not a wrong answer that this lane owns, and the builder's description is probably inaccurate. The viewer canvas renders the document graph: view_snapshot refuses no_graph_outputs when the graph has no outputs (render.rs:513-518). A document.new layout has an empty graph (document_new.rs:313-327). layout_place.rs:313-322 adds the picture through new_layer (layers.rs:77-83), which creates no graph operation, and layout.draw_frame does the same for text frames (layout_ui.rs:1016-1048). So the frame layer is most likely not drawn on the canvas at all, rather than drawn at the spread origin (UNVERIFIED by run). The layout PDF is the output the lane owns, and drawing pages on the canvas is panel or egui work, out of scope. Action: correct the docs line only (see lead_questions).
checked: Undo step (READ): Run::submit_layout_and_entry, harness.rs:2103-2159, mirrors restructure_and_entry_step. A refused layout half returns with nothing changed. A refused entry write undoes the layout step quietly, and keeping_redo_without_new_step restores the redo history. The step gets entry = EntryRestore(previous bytes, None when absent). The layout arm of history_step (harness.rs:2322-2341) applies the layout inverse, then swap_entry, and carries the swapped-out bytes into the opposite step, so undo then redo restores the document, layout_records and raster_records together. The test layout_place.rs one_place_is_one_undo_step... compares both entries byte for byte. History does not survive reopen (a new Run). Save and reopen keeps both entries and the tiles, and the test asserts the same PDF sha256 after reopen. If swap_entry fails after a layout inverse is applied, the step is dropped half-undone, as in the existing timeline arm; a canceled token fails the layout submit first, so this is low.

Run rows and action_records (READ): asset.fit is a typed row (Viewer::fit_graphic, recordable false, mutates true). document.submit_layout_and_entry is a Run row naming the new pub fn. tests/action_records.rs:312-331 scans impl Run pub fns, and the new fn is on one line with &mut self and covered by the row. Ids stay unique. The recordable list is unchanged. harness_drive_typed's sweep (:367-385): asset.fit with {} gets parameter_missing (layer and fit are required) and an undeclared key gets parameter_unknown, through check_declared before any decode.

place.rs refactor (READ): source_for (place.rs:824-848) is the old inline sharing block with the same predicate (width, height, linked uri and digest, embedded digest), the same id minting, staging only for a new embedded source, and `shared` as a bool. place_inner's result JSON is unchanged. The new branch order on artboard documents: place_doc, then pages_only false, then frame_needs_pages only when frame options are given (they were parameter_unknown before), then the old checks. SourceImage gains only ppi, set by decode_source. Every PlaceOptions literal in the tree uses ..Default (tests/place_asset.rs, commands/place.rs:51). No test expects canvas_unavailable.

Fit maths (READ, layout fitting.rs:81-196): zero and negative frame sides refuse in check_frame (side_ok) and in fit_content. Non-finite values refuse. Extreme aspect ratios give finite, positive scales. fit_content and Folio refuse a crop that empties the content box. frame_to_content converts the spread frame back to page coordinates (only x carries the page offset; place_graphic puts y at 0 for every page). Graphic frames have no rotation or shear field, and transform.move, free_transform and reset refuse graphic_frame_transform_unsupported before the layer lookup.

PDF resolver (READ): pdf longdoc.rs graphic_layer maps tile pixels through g.transform (content to spread) and page.map, so the picture lands at the frame and not at the spread origin. The lane scales content_size by tile-grid extent / source pixels, which gives cw/srcw pt per source pixel, including when fully transparent cells are skipped, because both the extent and px_w come from the tiles present. The clip uses the fitted frame shape. Tiles are rgb_f32le linear with straight alpha and the linear working profile, the same convention resampled_tiles writes. A body that is absent or the wrong length makes the layer unresolved (loss raster_unresolved), never a partial draw. Raster layers without a frame still resolve to nothing, as with NoAssets.

JobPort (READ): layout_pdf_bytes has exactly one caller, export_layout_pdf (git grep), which runs inside as_export_job (layout_export.rs:534-552, 736-744). The link refusal happens inside the admitted job, after refuse_existing and before write_atomic, so it writes nothing and settles Failed(code). R60 failure class export-job-not-admitted-jobport is not repeated.

Link states (READ): resolved goes on; modified, missing, unauthorized and unsupported refuse placed_link_<state>, and an unauthorized refusal names only the layer. A missing link base refuses link_base_unknown. Update All Links re-reads a frame source through placement_tiles -> source_tiles (no canvas clip) and keeps the frame record, and a change in pixel dimensions refuses graphic_frame_source_resized before anything commits.

Budgets (READ): the frame guard `len >= MAX_GRAPHIC_FRAMES` (layout_place.rs:304) refuses the 65537th frame, and Folio also refuses more than 65536 (longdoc.rs:1759). read_bounded with MAX_SOURCE_BYTES runs before any decode (:287). The declared PNG IHDR and PSD header pixel count is checked against MAX_PLACE_PIXELS before decode (:288). The decoded count is checked again (:294), and resampled_tiles bounds the region (place.rs:625).

ppi receipt (READ): asset.place returns ppi [x, y] and ppi_source decoder or default (layout_place.rs:297-354). The content size is pixels x 72 / ppi per axis, and list_placements derives actual_ppi and effective_ppi from the stored content size and the fit scale. The TIFF test covers 144 ppi -> 32 x 24 pt.
